findings.issue: The guard `&& sellerId != null` was removed. For an owner-less offer that still carries a sellerName, `sellerNames.putIfAbsent(PLATFORM_SELLER, offer.sellerName())` can now label the PLATFORM shipment with a third-party seller's display name. putIfAbsent means the first line wins, so a mixed cart could show the wrong name on the platform shipment. This only affects display, and it cannot happen today because offers.seller_id is NOT NULL.
findings.fix: Only record the name when the owner is known: `if (offer.sellerName() != null && offer.sellerId() != null)`.

summary: Delta 4ea8ca92..64fdb21d. afbb4270 changes tests only. 64fdb21 keeps an owner-less offer line's order_item and shipment at PLATFORM and sends sellerId=null only on the inventory reserve line. Order.assignShipments takes the item seller first, so the allocation's seller is ignored and item and shipment agree. (1) Ledger and visibility: if stock came from seller S, the shipment and revenue would sit with PLATFORM. Seller S would not see that shipment in its seller views, which are scoped by seller_id, so it does not leak to S or any other seller. Stock integrity holds because inventory reservation rows record the real owner S, and commit and release work by order id against those rows. Payout to S would be wrong, but the path still cannot be reached: offers.seller_id is NOT NULL, so the product view always returns sellerId. The design is conservative and fails toward the platform, not toward a wrong seller, so it is not major. (2) Reservation is still fail-closed. ReservationService (unchanged in this delta) adds an owner hint only when sellerId is non-null; otherwise it resolves the owner itself and rejects the line if it cannot. Order-side, null is sent only for offers marked owner-less, and known-owner lines still send their sellerId. (3) Nothing else new: no new endpoints, auth changes, dependencies, secrets or PII. The test-only SQL concatenation in OrderPlacementIntegrationTest uses constant table names, and the inventory concurrency test tightens a bound. One minor display finding (sellerName mapped to PLATFORM).
